description: New Brunswick Department of Transportation and Infrastructure Highway Network / Réseau des autoroutes du Ministère des Transports et de l’Infrastructure du Nouveau-Brunswick is a dataset listed in Province of New Brunswick open data portal (gnb.socrata.com), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Province of New Brunswick. This dataset contains a linear reference network of the roads and highways that are managed by the Department of Transportation and Infrastructure (DTI). Highways are identified by road name and route number. Roads are segmented by DTI control section identifier and functional class. Coverage: New Brunswick. The portal files it under the category Roads, Driving and Transport. Its tags are mti, route publique non entretenue, route de la section de contrôle, réseau, public not maintained. The table has 19 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Transportation and Infrastructure / Ministère des Transports et de. The portal shows 2026-04-21 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is New Brunswick Open Government Licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-gnb-socrata-com-portal.
